inputs.name: cinc_version
inputs.description: Cinc Client release to install, from https://omnitruck.cinc.sh/stable/cinc/versions/all.

inputs.name: checksums
inputs.description: SHA-256 of the package for each platform, by "PLATFORM/VERSION/ARCH". Change these with cinc_version.

inputs.name: repo_path
inputs.description: Directory on the host that holds cookbooks/, and roles/ if you use them. Whatever can write here can run anything as root, so keep it writable by root alone.

inputs.name: run_list
inputs.description: What to converge, such as ["recipe[nginx]", "role[web]"]. When empty, the circuit only installs the client.

inputs.name: schedule
inputs.description: systemd OnCalendar expression that converges on a timer, such as "hourly" or "*:0/30". When null, there is no timer.

inputs.name: converge_trigger
inputs.description: Any string, such as a cookbook's hash or a Git commit. Changing it converges on the next apply, for when something the circuit can't see has changed.
